name: BSP_DecalSystem_LoadDefinitions
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); analysis-only packet app_initialize_map, no reconstruction. Called at 0073de8c. References scripts/datatables/decals.lua and the per-decal keys Radius, Texture, Shader, Decals, FadeOutTime, LifeTime and Maxnum. Evidence: docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md; reports/app_initialize_map.json. | Packet app_init_world_effects: __thiscall(ECX = 0x1c object allocated at 0073de6d), RET, EAX = this. Base ctor 0073fa70 publishes it at 00e1aea0. Loads scripts/datatables/decals.lua (length 0x1d), pushes the global 'Decals' and iterates it; each table-valued element allocates a 0x28 record built by 00740410. Layout: +0x00/+0x04 name, +0x08 Maxnum int (00b66290), +0x0c Size float (key 00cff278), +0x10 Radius float, +0x14 decal.mvfm format from the ctor, +0x18 Texture via renderer vtable +0x64, +0x1c Shader via vtable +0x48, +0x20 LifeTime float, +0x24 FadeOutTime float. Appended to a doubling vector at base+0x10, count+0x14, capacity+0x18, growth 0073e9a0 with max(1, cap*2). Installed file defines exactly three entries with all seven keys. See docs/APP_INIT_WORLD_EFFECTS.md. | Run-time evidence from bsp_game.exe milestone 2c (packet cc_exe_2c), `--frames 120 --press-start-frame 30` against the installed game; see docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md. Parses 3 decal definitions out of the installed scripts/datatables/decals.lua through the mounted VFS: machine_gun_decal, explosion_hole and landscape_hole, every field matching the file. 0073fa70 publishes the system at 00e1aea0 first.

name: BSP_LeakManager_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall(leak_model, float dt) RET 4, on the object at unit+10D4h that 00818404 labels leakManager. Not a force list: three parallel arrays, rates at +18h, water at +1Ch and float3 points at +20h with count at +14h. Pass 1 snaps rates under 0.001f (00D7A23C) to zero, accumulates the raw rate into +2Ch and adds min(rate, cap at +8h)*dt of water; pass 2 re-sums the water into +28h, which is unit+10FCh because 0x10D4+0x28 == 0x10FC; the cap (1-health)*settings[404h]*capacity scales every water value and zeroes every rate when it bites; +24h = total > 0.01f (00D7A238). This is the producer of the extra mass 009329C0 reads at 00932A2C and 00933A3A. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md
